title: Matcha White-Choc Custard Taiyaki
hookLine: Crisp golden waffle-pressed taiyaki stuffed with ceremonial matcha cream & melted white choc.

steps.title: Heat Oil & Prep Cooling Rack
steps.instructionTemplate: Pour neutral frying oil into a heavy pot to 2 inches deep and heat steadily to 350°F (175°C). Set a wire cooling rack over paper towels nearby and measure out {flour_ty} and {milk_ty} so everything is ready to fry cleanly.

steps.title: Mix Smooth Waffle Batter
steps.instructionTemplate: Whisk {flour_ty} and {milk_ty} into a glossy pourable batter. Close the lid and cook until deeply golden brown and steam slows down, then lift carefully onto a wire rack so the crust stays crisp.

steps.title: Fill Center & Press Golden
steps.instructionTemplate: Pour half batter into preheated taiyaki/waffle iron, spoon {matcha_ty} in center, cover with remaining batter, and press 4–5 minutes until crisp.
steps.creatorSecret: Wait 60 seconds after opening the press so the exterior crisps up nicely.

steps.title: Drain Crisp, Toss & Serve Fresh
steps.instructionTemplate: Transfer to the wire rack to drain excess oil for 1–2 minutes while still piping hot, then finish with {matcha_ty}. Serve Matcha White-Choc Custard Taiyaki fresh while the exterior is shatteringly crisp.

ugcQuotes.quote: Turned out bakery-grade on my first try! Ready in 14 mins.
